reason: MotionBricks subproject ships synthetic-data training scripts that read configs from the repo and can run a few steps on CPU with no gated resources.
demo: motionbricks/README.md Training section: python scripts/train_vqvae.py (synthetic data)
goal: Install the motionbricks subproject (cd motionbricks; pip install -e .) in a CPU-only environment, then make `python scripts/train_vqvae.py --max_steps 20 --batch_size 4 --num_samples 40` run from the motionbricks directory to completion and print 'Training complete.'. check: Running the VQVAE synthetic-data training for 20 steps on CPU exits successfully, logs the start banner and 'Training complete.' with no traceback.
